title: Midday Sunwatch
text:
🌤️ Midday Sunwatch — October 27, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B3.0)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B3.7 (Peaked October 27, 2026 at 09:32 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 415 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 2.00)
🚨 NOAA Alert: Electron 2MeV Integral Flux exceeded 1,000pfu

Energetic electrons are elevated around Earth! 🛰⚡🔌🚀

A broad central coronal-hole region stands out in today’s EUV views, while the coronagraph shows no clear CME.

Images: NASA SDO/AIA — 193, 335, 171, 304, 131, 94 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
